backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor with no implemented logic.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence listing template-variant and refinement-related frontend files and associated metadata.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON mapping of frontend file paths to short descriptions of their purposes.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base styles and OKLCH color variables defining light and dark theme palettes.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point loading fonts and bootstrapping the React app.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React component managing chat messages, assistant state, and quick replies.
Header showing assistant avatar, title, and subtitle.
frontend/src/components/chat/Composer.ts: Text input composer for sending user messages with enter handling.
frontend/src/components/chat/MessageBubb: Renders user or bot message bubbles with styling and optional bot avatar.
frontend/src/components/chat/MessageList: Scrollable container rendering the ordered list of chat bubbles.
frontend/src/components/chat/QuickReplie: Button list for showing selectable quick-reply options.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook creating and managing the backend actor, reacting to identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Internet Identity auth hook and provider handling login, identity loading, and status states.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind layers and CSS variables for light and dark themes with warm color palettes, and applies base styling for borders and body.
frontend/src/lib/assistant/emailTypes.ts: Declares email type metadata with labels and trigger keywords and provides a lookup helper.
frontend/src/lib/assistant/engine.ts: Core message-processing logic that detects intent, manages assistant phases, collects data, and generates or refines drafts.
frontend/src/lib/assistant/intent.ts: Determines whether a message expresses email intent and identifies specific email types using trigger matching.
frontend/src/lib/assistant/questions.ts: Provides common and type-specific questions and functions to retrieve the next required question for data collection.
frontend/src/lib/assistant/refinements.t: Implements refinement actions such as tone changes and length adjustments, generating updated email drafts.
frontend/src/lib/assistant/state.ts: Handles assistant state updates, checks data collection completion, and provides state reset functionality.
frontend/src/lib/assistant/templates.ts: Provides email draft generator functions for each EmailType, producing template-based email text with tone-aware closings.
frontend/src/lib/assistant/templateVaria: Defines optional template variants for specific email types and utilities to generate drafts using those variants.
frontend/src/lib/assistant/types.ts: Defines message, email type, assistant state, and process result types for the email-writing assistant.
frontend/src/lib/assistant/updates.ts: Parses user messages to detect updates such as tone, date, and recipient changes and returns structured field/value pairs.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider and renders the main App component.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind CSS theme, colors, animations, and plugins including typography, container queries, and animate.
project_state.json: Describes the project’s state, features, architecture, and requirements for the frontend-only email-writing assistant.
